However, the input specification fixes the tensor shape at [16, 256, 256], which is a 3D tensor. Since the input is always 3D, the mutated kernel (argmin_kernel_2d) is never invoked. The argmin_kernel_3d code is identical between original and mutant, so behavior is always identical. This explains why all 112 rounds of differential testing passed - the mutation is in unreachable code given the fixed 3D input shape.
rounds.kill_strategy: This mutant is unkillable under the fixed-shape contract. The mutation is in argmin_kernel_2d which handles 2D tensors, but the input is always 3D ([16, 256, 256]). To kill this mutant would require changing the input shape to 2D, which violates the testing contract.
rounds.recommendations: When applying mutation testing to GPU kernels with multiple code paths based on tensor dimensionality, ensure mutants in dimension-specific kernels are only tested with inputs that actually trigger those code paths. The test harness should either: (1) vary input dimensionality as part of the testing contract, or (2) filter out mutants in unreachable kernel branches for the given fixed input specification.
